name: osis
description: OSIS Agent plugin for Codex and Claude Code. Talks to the local OSIS Agent Broker over HTTP so agents never need to know real OSIS ports.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the local OSIS modeling app from Codex
interface.longDescription: Select an OSIS instance, look up the real OSIS Python API and run Python against the open model. All traffic stays on 127.0.0.1 through the OSIS Agent Broker.
defaultPrompt: List the OSIS models I have open.
Check the current model and modify the material parameters, then run the analysis.
